2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify the accuracy of the vm_util folio-order detection helpers, is_backed_by_folio() and is_range_backed_by_folio_orders(). The test faults in memory with only one THP order enabled at a time and checks that the helpers report exactly that order. This ensures that the helpers agree with the kernel's idea of the backing before khugepaged mTHP tests rely on them.

reviews.author: Mike Rapoport
reviews.summary: Reviewer Mike Rapoport questioned the use of quotes in the perror() message, suggesting that open(/proc/self/pagemap) would be sufficient.
reviews.raw_body:
Do we need quotes in perror() message?
open(/proc/self/pagemap) will do I think.

2026-08-03.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify the accuracy of the vm_util folio-order detection helpers, which are used by khugepaged mTHP tests to detect collapse results. The test faults in memory for each supported anon THP order and checks that the helpers report exactly that order, ensuring they agree with the kernel's understanding of the backing. This patch is part of a larger series of patches and has been verified on x86-64 and arm64 architectures.
